These talisman-like objects bestow myriad benefits upon their bearers.

Periapts obtained from battles can be acquired by defeating the listed [[Voidwatch]] notorious monster with a white spectral alignment greater than 0%. The white alignment is equal to the chance of acquring the periapt at the end of the battle.
